mapper.insert: insert into logistics (order_id, company, tracking_no, status, estimated_arrival) values (#{orderId}, #{company}, #{trackingNo}, #{status}, #{estimatedArrival})
mapper.update: update logistics set company = #{company}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, status = 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select max(tracking_no) from logistics where tracking_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
